summary: Extended the configuration-recovery account with receipt 4178d9d5c479470cafb7ebd7951a9332, which measures the previously argued multi-node consequence of an empty recovered configuration. The receipt shows node A restarting with the flag on and tracking no configuration at all (event 15: latest index 0, no members) and then, with the other voters shut down and no leader heard, staying a follower in all 266 samples of a 1500ms window and never entering Candidate (witness event 16, comparison violated), while the same node and log restarted with the replay disabled recovered the three-voter configuration (event 17) and was a candidate in 254 of 266 samples, ending in state Candidate (event 18, comparison holds) - so an empty tracked configuration makes a voter unable even to attempt authority. The rationale now carries that paragraph, the observation-window counter is strengthened with the control's sample counts (a window that produced 254 candidate samples for the control produced zero for the defective node), and a new counterevidence item bounds the reading (the other voters were removed by construction, so the receipt shows a capability difference rather than a counterfactual outage). joint_history is extended to four receipts; conclusion, knowledge uses and limitations are otherwise unchanged. Both questions now rest on four and five receipts respectively with no open gaps.
